name: Secure Drive
summary: An encrypted shared folder on your router's USB drive or any network share. The drive holds only ciphertext; approved computers hold the keys. Documents, spreadsheets, drawings and any file, with a signed access log.

screenshots.alt: Secure Drive listing encrypted documents, a spreadsheet and a drawing on a router share, with a verified-log banner and the Files, Activity and Computers tabs

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Read and write encrypted objects in folders you pick, such as a router's shared USB drive
Keep this computer's drive keys in its data folder, locked by a passphrase you choose
Write a decrypted copy only when you choose Save a decrypted copy or Open in another app
Copy an invitation code you ask to copy, and clear it when you close the dialog
